title: Uncaught Exceptions
instructions: What happens if an exception is thrown and there is no try-catch block to handle it?

options.text: The exception is ignored and the program continues normally
The program crashes and stops running
Kotlin automatically fixes the error and retries
The program skips the line that caused the error and moves on

explanation: If an exception is thrown and no try-catch block handles it, the program crashes. This is why error handling matters -- especially on an FRC robot, where a crash during a match means your robot stops responding.
